title: Halo: The Master Chief Collection

custody.physical: Steam digital edition · Xbox Game Studios build
custody.condition: Account-bound license on the archive Steam account. No physical media is part of this accession.

curatorNotes: Reserved for curator writing on Halo: The Master Chief Collection as the archive’s consolidated Halo digital filing.
collectionNotes: Digital ownership confirmed via Steam. No physical edition is held. Official cover artwork has been entered from Steam library art. The collection integrates multiple Halo campaigns under a single Steam license.

preservation.playableOn: Windows PC through Steam under archive custody
preservation.compatibility: Continued access requires the archive account, Steam’s support for the title, and Xbox / Microsoft services where the client requires them.
preservation.concerns: Compilation holdings depend on account-bound licensing and ongoing online services for multiplayer components. Individual campaign packages may be revised in place by storefront updates. No offline installer is held.
preservation.knownRevisions: The Master Chief Collection originated on Xbox One in 2014. The Steam PC edition is dated December 3, 2019. This accession records the licensed digital compilation in custody.
preservation.availability: Playable from the archive Steam library for as long as that license and the required services remain intact.
